description: op-to-op latency CI golden (Wormhole, wh_n300_civ2). Runs under TT_METAL_PROFILER_ACCUMULATE=1 so the per-program L1->DRAM profiler dump does not land in the op2op gap (reviewer request: otherwise the gap is inflated by profiler writeout). ARMED (tolerance_pct=10): centered on the wh_n300_civ2 CI run after the Device 2.0 data-movement API uplift (Noc/CircularBuffer). The gated (mean) op2op is unchanged by the uplift - official_op2op_us=2.05, pack_to_unpack_op2op_us=4.72 - and falls within the pre-uplift multi-run baselines (official 1.956-2.034, pack_to_unpack 4.376-4.718). tolerance_pct=10 gives ~2.5x margin over the observed run-to-run spread; revisit as more runs land.
